cost_ratio_vs_llm_judge.estimate: Assumes 1.0s per remote LLM judge call.

field_principles.cost_ratio_vs_llm_judge: The EFFICIENCY axis: the executable verifier is a microsecond forward constraint check vs an LLM-judge call; quantifies the 'parity at 10-100x cheaper' north-star claim cheaply.
field_principles.headroom_present: Bare bool: oracle@K > vote@1. The positive control -- a null is only a moat finding when headroom exists (per the FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK discipline).
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. A real CI-excl-0 lift, an honest A~=vote null, OR an honest no-headroom report are ALL COMPLETE and decision-grade.
field_principles.oracle_at_k: Fraction of puzzles with >=1 exact-valid candidate; the ceiling the verifier could recover toward.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition for the bootstrap CI.
field_principles.rerank_lift_vs_vote: pass@1(verifier-rerank) - vote@1, with bootstrap CI95. CI95 excluding 0 = the verifier moat at the rerank level (the .385 decision-grade headline).
field_principles.verifier_recovers_outvoted: Count of present-but-out-voted puzzles the executable verifier recovers (ARBITER framing); the mechanistic evidence the external signal is orthogonal to the vote.
field_principles.vote_at_1: Majority-vote exact-accuracy; the self-consistency baseline the external verifier must beat.
